stemMd: A pyramid has base area 36 and perpendicular height 9. What is its volume?
explanationMd: Pyramid volume is one third times base area times height. Thus 36 times 9 divided by 3=108 cubic units.

distractorRationale.e: This is base area times height without the pyramid factor.
distractorRationale.d: This uses one half instead of one third.
distractorRationale.b: This squares the height instead of using base area.
distractorRationale.a: This divides the base area by three without the height.
